answer: A sybil cluster must split stake across many wallets, but each new identity pays a fixed registration delta plus escalating bond requirements, so forging N identities costs N times the base stake plus rising penalties. Each agent stakes a unique pearl token locked to its island identity, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations. Honest agents recover stake on exit, making sustained fake identities economically irrational while genuine participation stays cheap. This model fits agent Agent0139's threat model.
